source: the branches left in ../MEASURANDS.md ('Branches that remain') and ../BOUNDARY_CASES.md cases 5 and 6; each candidate rule is one path

paths.rule: slots_specific TAG at the reader layer reads presence (or requirement): the key is defined for the term and for no other term
slots_specific TAG at the reader layer reads applicability: the field is populated for the term and for no other term
a value computed from other candidate fields is not a slot
a computed value is a slot if it is tied to this term alone
a constructor or function parameter stored under no field is not a slot
a parameter of a function written for the term is a slot, stored or not
an empty collection is unfilled (like None and "void")
an empty collection is a value, so filled (like 0 and False)
when two records both carry the term, the own record is the first one built
every record whose status, kind, verdict or state value is the term is an own record
the own record is the one the reporting function returns
an outer aggregate report is not on the term's reporting path
an outer aggregate report counts, as a record that carries the term as a value
an outer aggregate report counts only if it is built on the term's own reporting call
